name: God Working Through You
overview: God works through believers who fully trust in Him rather than relying on their own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 emphasizes. He has good plans for His people, promising peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus assures His followers that by believing in Him, they will do the works He did and even greater ones, demonstrating that God empowers His people to be His instruments (John 14:12). This partnership is rooted in abiding in Christ, the true vine, with the Father as the cultivator, enabling spiritual fruitfulness (John 15:1). Believers who walk by the Spirit and not the flesh live free from condemnation and become a visible light to the world, reflecting God's presence and purpose through their lives (Romans 8:1; Matthew 5:14).
